symptom: Database connection pool exhausted during peak traffic
root_cause: max_connections in db_pool.yaml was lowered below active worker count
resolution: Reverted db_pool.yaml and recycled idle database connections

symptom: Webhook retries delayed after provider signature rotation
root_cause: Signing secret was not updated when the payment provider rotated it
resolution: Updated the signing secret and replayed failed webhooks

symptom: Cart page latency above 3 seconds after cache eviction
root_cause: Cache TTL change caused a cold-cache stampede
resolution: Restored the TTL and warmed the cart cache

root_cause: Pricing rules were read from an outdated replica
resolution: Pointed pricing reads to the primary and cleared the rules cache

symptom: Single sign-on login failures from expired SAML certificate
root_cause: SAML signing certificate expired without a renewal reminder
resolution: Installed the renewed certificate and restarted auth pods

symptom: Token refresh latency during morning login surge
root_cause: Autoscaling minimum was too low for the login peak

symptom: Search cluster yellow after node disk filled
root_cause: Log retention was not applied to one data node
resolution: Purged old indices and fixed the retention policy

symptom: Product search results lagging behind catalog updates
root_cause: Indexer batch size was too small after catalog growth
resolution: Increased indexer batch size and reindexed

root_cause: Export job and archive job locked the same table

symptom: Push notifications delayed after mobile certificate expiry
resolution: Renewed the certificate and redelivered pending notifications

symptom: Nightly dashboard aggregation missed its schedule
root_cause: Cron timezone changed during a scheduler upgrade
resolution: Set the scheduler timezone to UTC and reran the job

symptom: Stock sync failing with partner API authorization errors
resolution: Rotated the credentials and reran the sync

symptom: Customer uploads rejected when storage quota was reached
root_cause: Bucket quota was not raised after client onboarding
resolution: Raised the quota and added a usage alert

symptom: TLS handshake failures after certificate rotation
root_cause: Intermediate certificate was missing from the new chain

symptom: Large PDF reports timing out for month-end users
root_cause: Report rendering ran synchronously in the request path
resolution: Moved rendering to a background job
